notes: Fixes for VWAP resets on daily charts, at the new year and at midnight.
changelog: Daily charts with Session or Daily reset now plot the VWAP from the first bar instead of showing nothing
Weekly and higher timeframe charts plot the VWAP whenever one bar covers the whole reset period
Weekly reset no longer restarts mid-week when the calendar year changes
The bar that closes exactly at midnight now stays in the day, week or month it traded in
